reasoning: Independent inspection of panel.png confirms a linear main-panel calibration from frame/tick anchors: x=0 at about pixel 150 and x=1 at about 634, and y=0 at about 468 with 20-unit spacing of about 57 pixels. The eligible series is the blue open-circle CO2 195K curve; the coral open-circle N2 77K curve is excluded. I inspected the full candidate CSV (46 rows), all review items and their native tiles, and the entire main panel, including the crowded low-pressure strip and plateau. Ten omitted plateau/intermediate CO2 rings are natively visible and were added. The candidate's final rightmost point was moved to the visible center of the rightmost ring. The inset rings, black text/arrow ink, and coral N2 markers were not treated as CO2 points. The crowded strip remains intrinsically overlapped at native resolution, so the result is source-backed but retained for review rather than silently promoted to unconditional acceptance.

uncertainties: Blue markers in the dense low-pressure strip overlap heavily; their existence is supported by visible arcs/white interiors, but individual centers have approximately 2.5 native-panel-pixel uncertainty.
Several plateau rings are close to connected blue line segments; additions were made only where a distinct open-circle contour and interior are visible in panel.png.
Axis tick-fit residuals are sub-pixel to about 0.6 pixel in the supplied calibration, so no material axis disagreement was found; this report does not replace downstream calibration.
